# Third-party resources

- OpenBangla riti dictionary: https://github.com/OpenBangla/riti — MPL-2.0. The adapted word array is in app/src/main/assets/bangla-words.js and the license is included. The keyboard embeds an 18,000-word subset, normalized for prefix lookup, with a small app-specific ordering seed.
- FrequencyWords: https://github.com/hermitdave/FrequencyWords — code MIT, content CC-BY-SA-4.0, as distinguished in the upstream README. Derived from its 2018 English 50k list, generated from OpenSubtitles 2018; only the first 12,000 alphabetic entries are embedded. The subset is filtered/adapted content and retains CC-BY-SA-4.0; it is not relicensed under the app's MIT license. See FrequencyWords-LICENSE.txt for code and FrequencyWords-CONTENT-LICENSE.txt for content.
- Unicode Emoji 16.0: https://unicode.org/Public/emoji/16.0/emoji-test.txt — © Unicode, Inc.; https://www.unicode.org/terms_of_use.html. Official emoji data is included and grouped for the picker. Emoji artwork is provided by the phone.
- Lucide 0.468.0: https://lucide.dev — ISC/MIT notices retained in its bundled script; license file included.
- Sounds: this public source uses Android system key feedback. No Apple audio recordings are included.
- Gradle wrapper: https://github.com/gradle/gradle — Apache-2.0, license headers retained in scripts. Android Gradle Plugin, Android SDK tools and Java are build dependencies and not included in the source archive.
